property_summary: For every admissible caller and block timestamp, when a player pays the exact ticket amount and the chain randomness yields a value equal to 0 modulo 2 (i.e. random%2==0) the reference contract always empties the pot (pot becomes 0); the mutant changing modulus to 3 can make the same block randomness produce random%3!=0 so the pot may remain nonzero, breaking that universal guarantee.
change_summary: Change the randomness modulus to 3 so the branching probability changes, affecting whether pot is zeroed and thus observable pot after play.
